interface.name: zsingularity_motion_manager_v1
interface.description: Lets a shell tell the compositor where the launcher icon of each application is, so windows can open from it, close into it and minimize into it. Rectangles are in the surface-local coordinates of the surface that shows the icon, usually a dock. The compositor ignores rectangles of surfaces that are not mapped or not visible.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the manager. Rectangles set through it are removed.

request.name: set_icon_rect

description.summary: set the icon rectangle of an application

request.description: Sets the rectangle of the icon that represents app_id on the given surface. A width or height of zero removes it. app_id is the desktop file id or the window app_id; the compositor matches it against window app_ids ignoring case and a .desktop suffix.

request.name: clear_icon_rects

description.summary: remove every icon rectangle of a surface

request.description: Removes all rectangles set for the surface, for example when the dock hides.

request.name: launch
request.description: Announces that the user launched app_id from its icon. The next window of that application opens from the icon rectangle. The announcement expires after a few seconds.
